Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.webbrowser.ext

Interface BrowserExtension

All Known Implementing Classes:
HttpsUpgradeExtension, MandelaUserscriptsExtension, PopupBlockerExtension, TrackerBlockerExtension
public interface BrowserExtension
The Web Browser extension SPI. Developers implement this interface and register the implementation with META-INF/services (either on the application classpath for a built-in, or inside a jar dropped into ~/.lg3d/webbrowser/extensions for a third-party extension); the browser discovers it with ServiceLoader.

Every hook except manifest() has a sensible default, so an extension implements only the behaviour it needs. Hooks are invoked by the ExtensionBroker on the browser's threads (navigation / popup / page-loaded on the JavaFX Application Thread, toolbar contributions realised on the EDT) and are individually guarded: an extension that throws is logged and skipped without disturbing the browser or the other extensions.

Capabilities are gated on the permissions the user granted in the extension manager; see BrowserContext and PageContext.executeScript(String).

    • onNavigate

      default NavigationDecision onNavigate(NavigationRequest request)
      Consulted before a navigation commits. Requires Permission.NAVIGATE; the first non-ALLOW verdict wins.
      Parameters:
      request - the navigation about to happen
      Returns:
      ALLOW (default), BLOCK, or REDIRECT to a different URL

    • onPopup

      default PopupDecision onPopup(PopupRequest request)
      Consulted when a page requests a popup. Requires Permission.POPUP; any BLOCK suppresses the popup.
      Parameters:
      request - the popup about to open
      Returns:
      ALLOW (default) or BLOCK

    • onPageLoaded

      default void onPageLoaded(PageContext page)

      page - the loaded page
